Google\'s recognition service is not available from Russia, and some foreign addresses do not open with some providers. So Food by photo works only with a VPN on. Without a VPN we try a workaround through a Russian address (Yandex Cloud), but on some networks it does not open and the photo will not send. The rest of the app works offline. You can change this in Settings → Food by photo key. If you do not use Food by photo, nothing is sent anywhere.
